verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas exposes a documented Editor API for scene manipulation, asset management, and custom tooling, plus a REST API (paid tier) and an official MCP server that lets AI assistants modify project data and verify results in the viewport — strong evidence of programmatic access mirroring editor actions. However, there's no formal OpenAPI spec (all candidate endpoints 404), no explicit claim of full UI/API feature parity, and some editor-only conveniences (drag-and-drop, real-time collaboration) aren't shown to have API equivalents. Missing for 10: a published API spec, explicit parity documentation, and independent confirmation that all UI actions are scriptable via API.
